summary.text: Scott Barger is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 80, which he has represented since December 2024, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot against Democrat Sarah Holland.
His career experience includes work as a pastor and radio host.

paragraphs.text: Barger graduated from Blair County Christian School in 1991 and earned a bachelor's degree from Grace College in 1996 and a master's degree in 2006.
